_note: The overlay's rootDirs are the project's winning rootDirs declaration plus the overlay tree, as svelte-check writes them; the workspace root is not added. With rootDirs [src, generated], a component's `../shared/x` leaves every root once seen from the overlay tree, so it is TS2307 there, while the same import in a plain .ts file resolves normally. Verified against svelte-check --tsgo.
